desc: This induction range features dual fan convection for more consistent baking results, every time.
hl: Unlike traditional electric and gas cooktops, Induction only heats the pan and the food in it, so the area around the pan stays cooler, allowing you to clean up spills and splatters while you cook.
Get faster, more even multi-rack baking with powerful dual convection fans that circulate hot air throughout the oven cavity.
With induction, heat transfers directly to the cookware bypassing the cooktop surface, making induction incredibly fast.
Lights up when the cooktop is turned on.
Monitors and alerts when the desired finished cooking temperature has been reached.
Our extending Glide Rack makes it easier to monitor and lift your food out of the oven.
